title: Gary Stearman's Cessna escorted by a walnut-shaped UFO
place_text: flight from Lubbock, Texas to Dallas

tellings.quote: The voice said, "If you look to your left, you'll see a UFO."

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, passes on a story he heard from a man named Gary Stearman about a flight in a Cessna, a small private plane, from Lubbock, Texas to Dallas. According to Alberino, a voice came over the radio saying "If you look to your left, you'll see a UFO," and Stearman's plane was then escorted by an object shaped like a walnut. If true, it would mean someone on the ground knew about the craft and was openly pointing it out to pilots.
